description: Look up what a temporary DNS name points at and how long it has left. No token is needed: everything it returns is already public in DNS. Use it to confirm a name exists and resolves the way you expect before handing it to someone else. It fails once the name has expired, and a name stops answering in the same second it falls due.

slug.description: The slug the service assigned, without the aisense- prefix and without the zone.

name: read_dns_name
title: Read a temporary DNS name
